segments.text: Intelligent people like you cannot build their dream physique
because you, my friend, have a disease called analysis paralysis
A photography professor split his class in two.
One group would be graded only on how many photos they took.
The other group had only one chance to take one perfect photo.
At the end, the best photos all came from the group taking the most photos. (take 2)
The perfect photo group just sat around thinking about perfection.
Repeated actions will teach you things your thoughts never can, no matter how intelligent you are. (take 2)
Stop chasing the perfect exercise, perfect diet, and the perfect workout program.
Bring it into existence first, then make it perfect,
With whatever knowledge you have right now, just start.
